verdict.rationale: The POS features page documents a background automation: low-stock notifications triggered by thresholds based on current sales rate, powered by Shopify Flow. Sidekick can also create stock transfers automatically, though only when asked rather than autonomously in the background. Evidence of user-configurable, general-purpose autonomous automations within POS is thin. Missing for 10: documented ability for users to define their own triggers and actions for POS, autonomous AI-agent operation beyond on-request Sidekick actions, details on Flow setup and scope for POS, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
